raw_signal: API weekly-limit 429 on alias claude1 (resets 2026-09-29 20:00 Asia/Aqtau); agent killed mid-work; partial artifacts preserved in qa-results/agent_custody_20260926/partial_after_quota/; respawn by description per 11.4.147(e).
_defect: This is the T127 task text's own named golden scenario ('the 2026-09-26 weekly-cap rows'), a REAL row copied byte-for-byte from docs/requests/agent_registry.jsonl:2524-2529 -- this project's own recorded instance of research.md DEC-14's RC-01 rationale event ('one weekly cap killed five concurrent agents at once'; this incident recorded SIX). No retry-after header is present in the note (a weekly/subscription cap is not a short-window per-request throttle); the note names an explicit multi-day-out reset instant ('resets 2026-09-29 20:00 Asia/Aqtau', ~3 days after the 2026-09-26T13:24:22Z kill) -- DEC-14's own disambiguator for cap over rate-limited ('no retry-after, or a named weekly/subscription reset', an OR of two conditions, BOTH of which this fixture happens to satisfy). Per contracts/agent-registry-and-handoff.md AR-005 + T-B06's own task text, class=cap means the resume must NEVER retry on alias claude1; it must rebind to an operational alias (section 11.4.196 native-first order) and mark claude1 cooled until 2026-09-29T20:00 Asia/Aqtau -- never a short backoff-then-resume-same-alias, which is what a (wrong) rate-limited classification would authorise, and exactly the misclassification lc_bad_cap_via_429_no_retry_after.json exists to catch.
